p4fx1fcx.baseName: Christmas Tree World 7ft Ultra Slim Mixed Pine Tree With Bag
p4fx1fcx.variantName: Christmas Tree World 7ft Ultra Slim Mixed Pine Tree With Bag
p4fx1fcx.sourceDescription: No longer does lack of space mean you can't have a realistic tree! When you choose the Ultra Slim Mixed Pine tree, you get the best of our realistic trees in a skinny silhouette ideal for those who have limited space but still want a luxurious festive feature! Incorporating PE plastic-moulded branch tips with traditional high-quality PVC branches, our Ultra Mixed Pines provide full, gap-free foliage that suit decorations wonderfully! They're also one of our fastest trees to erect, giving you extra time to relax with the family. You'll also be pleased to find that this 7ft slim Christmas tree includes a mixture of hinged and attached/fold-down branches, making the branches easy to bend into shape. Picture shows 7ft tree in our range. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. Product Features • Comes with a storage bag(s) • Size: 7ft • Number of Branch Tips: 1346 PE/PVC branch tips • Tree Width: 84cm diameter • Slim Profile: Great choice for when space is limited • Foliage colour: Realistic dark green • Realistic look: Ultra realistic Plastic moulded tips and traditional PVC tips to fill out any gaps • Easy assembly: Attached Hinged Branches • Sturdy base: Folding metal stand with plastic tips to prevent scratching • Fire-resistant: Fire retardancy certified • Indoor use only: The trees construction will rust in rain • Height measured from the floor • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom

n5y6462n.baseName: Artemis Home 6ft Hartenshaw Pre-Lit PE/PVC Artificial Christmas Tree
n5y6462n.variantName: Artemis Home 6ft Hartenshaw Pre-Lit PE/PVC Artificial Christmas Tree
n5y6462n.sourceDescription: Bring a traditional woodland feel to your Christmas display with the Hartenshaw pre-lit artificial Noble Fir. Its mix of PE and PVC foliage provides natural-looking branch detail, with 4,344 tips and 500 LEDs on the 6ft tree, or 6,466 tips and 650 LEDs on the 7ft version. Use the foot pedal to choose warm white or multicolour lighting, with steady, twinkling and flashing options, plus a setting that alternates between the two colours. Both sizes include a metal stand and plastic storage bag, ready for displaying your tree and packing it away after Christmas. Adult assembly required. For indoor use only. Artemis Home Ltd. 335A Torquay Road, Paignton, TQ3 2EP

4ptt4ct7.baseName: Walplus 300 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree Quick Setup - Green - 180 cm
4ptt4ct7.variantName: Walplus 300 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree Quick Setup - Green - 180 cm
4ptt4ct7.sourceDescription: This unique and contemporary decorative piece features a modern cone shape and is crafted primarily for both indoor and outdoor use. The design aligns perfectly with the Christmas season, where its textured PVC finish and elegant green hue contribute to a festive atmosphere, whether in your living room or on the garden terrace. Textured Cone Design This decorative piece flaunts a cone-shaped structure that elevates any setting with its intricate textures and striking elegance. Designed for ultimate visual appeal, its unique form captivates, providing an aesthetically pleasing focal point in both living rooms and garden spaces. Decorative String Lights Adorned with strands of decorative string lights, this item transforms spaces with its glow. These lights are specially crafted for festive occasions, lending an enchanting ambiance to every corner they grace, seamlessly transitioning between daytime decor and evening illumination. LED Warmth The built-in LED light source emits a warm white hue, creating a cozy and inviting atmosphere irrespective of the location. With LEDs known for their energy efficiency and lasting lifespan, enjoy a consistent and pleasant luminescence throughout the celebration season. Versatile Usage Perfect for indoor and outdoor settings, this piece seamlessly adapts to diverse environments. Whether nestled amidst living room decor or poised elegantly on a garden terrace, it merges effortlessly with its surroundings, boosting festive cheer everywhere. Simple Assembly Required While assembly is required, the process is straightforward and can be completed by two people. Every component comes with clear instructions, ensuring each piece fits perfectly, so you can quickly enjoy a charming seasonal display without hassle. Product Specifications Colour: Green Material: PVC and steel Tree height: 180 cm Bottom diameter: 90 cm Stand size: 40 cm Durable Decorate with cones Lifelike branch tips with frosted snow Number of pine cones: 12 Lights type: Decorative string lights Lights color: Warm white Number of LEDs: 300 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1xChristmastree,1xLEDstringlight,1xPeak,40x6cmball,40x4cmball,40x3cmball This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd
